To: #announcements
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Linden Pantry charity stream — Nov 21

@everyone charity stream is happening Saturday, Nov 21, 10am–10pm for Linden Community Pantry!!

Last year we raised $212, which was awesome, but I posted so late that half the server didn’t even know until basically the day of 😭 so here’s your actual warning this time. Our goal is $600, and Rook is matching the first $100 people donate, so those early donations count double.

Donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz

It goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off. Denise from the pantry said they’re serving around 340 families a week right now, and through their wholesale partner, $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food. Even $3 helps. And seriously, if you can’t give, no guilt at all.

If you don’t have a card or just can’t donate, you can still help: show up, share the stream or donation link, hang out in chat, or join the games. You can also drop canned and boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on Saturdays from 9–1.

First half is community lobbies — anyone can join, I’ll drop the code. Second half, chat votes on a game every 2 hours. No repeat maps, Larry, I promise.

And yes, there are incentives:

$100 — I play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and I dye it ON STREAM
$400 — one hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry (the pantry buys the food directly with the donations)

For anyone thinking charity streams are just begging with extra steps: it’s not begging if you get hair dye content out of it lol

Come hang out even if it’s just for a bit. See you Nov 21 💚
